prompt: Build a 3-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 3 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H). This is the standard ising_field_coupling_3q task's Hamiltonian (H = 0.3*Z0 + 0.5*Z1 - 0.2*Z2 + 0.4*Z0*Z1) with a REVERSED qubit-ordering convention: relabel every qubit index i there as (2-i) here, giving H = -0.2*Z0 + 0.5*Z1 + 0.3*Z2 + 0.4*Z2*Z1 (single-qubit field terms plus one pairwise coupling term). gamma = 0.5. Any correct implementation is accepted. No measurement.
